title: Just go out and do it!
text:
Everything was terrific! Pickup at hotel was on time and seamless. Vladi our mountain guide was very experienced, knowledgeable and overall great
Person. Great to do the hike and be outside of Barcelona. Loved going to the small community after for a Clara beer, get a feel for the village and village life. Would highly recommend!
author: L6773GWmc

title: Fresh Mountain Air
text: This was a really fun and beautiful trip. The drive to Queralbs is really pretty. We got lucky with good weather until we reached the top - it was snowing. I like snow, so it was a good thing. This is a really famous pilgrimage in Catalunya, so if you're into hiking and like the mountains, I'd highly recommend it. The hike itself is all uphill, so I would recommend the La Garrotxa hike instead  if you are not in at least decent shape. Shoes with tread are a must so you don't slip. Ramon is awesome - he's very knowledgeable and kind.
author: HippoSlippers
